issue.title: Custom gate input panel hides sibling OR decisions while an AND form is open
issue.description:
# Custom gate input panel hides alternative decisions

Proposed by sase-1ou.5.1.4 note 8. Independently reproduced by the epic lander
on sase d1a576ab4e73b1564d93bdb879b49f6660dda0d4, 2026-10-28.

A synthetic custom gate declares `(attest AND approve) OR rotation_only OR defer
OR reject`. The primary branch has one required line input. A StyledGateTestApp
pilot at 120x40 opens the modal and presses `1`. The active screen becomes
GateInputPanel. Its only buttons are gate-input-submit and gate-input-cancel;
it contains zero gate-singleton controls. All three alternative controls remain
on the underlying CustomGateModal. No gate is created and no command executes.

Source: GateBranchControls._request_for_branch passes only the selected branch's
options; _open_input_panel pushes a separate ModalScreen. GateInputPanel composes
only selected inputs, Submit, and Cancel. The user must leave the input panel
before choosing an alternative branch. The owner's screenshot confirms this
problem with the actual historical-remediation gate.

Remediation: make all alternative branches visible and reachable during typed
input collection. Preserve per-branch drafts and validation; switching to reject
must not submit or validate the primary branch. Verify a mixed AND/OR gate at
compact and wide sizes, keyboard and mouse, and relevant visual snapshots.

This predates the remediation epic: the branch-input handoff is from ae2916200c
(sase-q3.3), and current Plan Decisions changes are gated by plan_compact. No
semantic duplicate was found in bug searches or the recent all-task sweep.

task_type_fields.impact: Owners cannot see or directly choose decline, defer, or rotation-only while the primary form is open, making consequential decisions harder to review. Keep sibling alternatives reachable, preserve drafts, and never submit the primary branch when switching.
task_type_fields.repro: Open a custom gate with (attest AND approve) OR rotation_only OR defer OR reject and a required primary input; press 1. The top GateInputPanel contains only Submit/Cancel and zero sibling branch controls; all 3 OR choices are behind it. Reproduced with StyledGateTestApp at 120x40 on d1a576ab4e.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1ou.5.1.4 note 8 reported that the owner could not see alternative purge decisions while filling the primary form. The lander independently reproduced the same modal behavior on current master; this predates the remediation epic.
